body.x: At the YEI Technology(www.yeitechnology.com) booth, visitors were able to test out the game in a wearable game suit 'The PrioVR' which gives a sense of immersion.

The PrioVR consists of sensors you strap onto your body to fully immerse yourself in video games or any other kind of virtual world. It makes use of triaxial gyroscopes, accelerometers and magnetometers, as well as sensor fusion – the combining of sensory data – to read your movements.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
